environment: Same Linux cloud executor, real MetaDrive/Panda3D with software rendering, headless Chromium; not measured on macOS.
workload: nuScenes scene-0980 updated map; 1x playback from step 0 until at least 20; three paused yaw drags at step 20; redraw 20, backward 20 to 5, forward 5 to 20.
caveats: Single accepted end-to-end run per version; timings vary by machine and load.
Adaptive display batching ends the optimized run at step 21 versus baseline step 20; source progression is compared per wall second. Every physics step is still executed.
Delivered FPS counts distinct decoded images actually observed at browser animation frames, not source step count.
Camera and scrub runs start at identical poses; the optimized run aligns to step 20 outside the timed playback.
Startup excluded from comparison because worker/cache warmness differs.
Short performance workload covers steps 0–21; correctness regression separately exercises later states and Argoverse.
